title: Jorlov's "CHASING THE DRAGON" - A Moody and Energetic UK Rap
htmlContent:
Jorlov is an up-and-coming UK rapper and producer based in LA, making waves in the underground scene with his unique sound. At only 21 years old, he has already worked with some big names, including DJ Boombox Cartel and rapper Felly. 

With "CHASING THE DRAGON," Jorlov showcases his talent as both a producer and a vocalist, delivering a moody and energetic UK rap that's hard to ignore.

The song features Jorlov's signature sound, blending smooth beats and catchy lyrics. The track's mood is dark and sexy, with Jorlov's voice adding a seductive edge to the lyrics. The song is a testament to Jorlov's talent as an artist, and it's clear that he has a bright future ahead of him in the music industry.
